subject: Syndicate Analytics - trial roadmap, success metrics, and ownership
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Klein <alex.klein@syndicateanalytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Syndicate Analytics - trial roadmap, success metrics, and ownership

Alex — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our call and a concrete POC plan so we have alignment going into the trial kickoff. High level: 3-week functional trial followed by a 2-week performance and cost validation window.

Key success criteria (proposal):
- Latency: p50 < 200 ms, p95 < 500 ms (measured on production-like traffic)
- Throughput: sustain 100 concurrent inference reqs/sec with autoscale margin +20%
- Cost: token cost <= $0.0007 / input+output token (targeted avg across sample workload)
- Quality: evaluation harness pass-rate >= 90% on the golden prompt set; hallucination incidents < 2%
- Stability: <1% error rate (5xx or timeouts) across the trial window

Evaluation plan (who/what/when):
- Week 0 (pre-kickoff): Redwood to deploy private trial tenant in your dev VPC and seed sample prompts (Ben + Infra) — deliverables: access, sample dataset, prep runbook
- Week 1 (functional): run through golden prompt set with annotated expected outputs; CS-led review (Marissa)
- Week 2 (stress & throughput): synthetic load tests to validate autoscaling and p95 latency
- Week 3 (cost run & quality validation): 48-hour steady-state run to compute cost/token and quality metrics

Owners and asks:
- Ben Carter (AM) — overall project owner, coordinate kickoff, deliver trial brief (attached), point of contact for technical questions
- Marissa Cole (Customer Success) — owns evaluation harness, data labeling/acceptance criteria, weekly QA checkpoints
- Alex / Syndicate — provide sample traffic profile, compliance checklist (if any), and procurement contact for contract steps

Attachments: syndicate_trial_brief.pdf (trial scope + env checklist), sample_prompts.csv (golden prompt set)

Requested next steps:
1) Confirm the success criteria above or send edits by EOD Wed (May 25)
2) Confirm access details for a dev VPC or allow Redwood to provision a temporary subnet
3) Pick a kickoff time for Monday (May 26) — I proposed a slot in the calendar link below

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

—
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0147

From: Alex Klein <alex.klein@syndicateanalytics.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@syndicateanalytics.com>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Syndicate Analytics - trial roadmap, success metrics, and ownership

Ben — really helpful recap, thanks. Couple of notes from our side after internal sync: 
- The latency/quality targets look reasonable. We'd like to relax throughput slightly to 80 reqs/sec sustained to match our current peak; we can iterate up if auto-scaling looks good.
- For cost, can you share the method you use to calculate token cost (what counts as input vs output, handling of tool calls/embeds)? We have legacy cost buckets that treat short context windows differently.
- Procurement asked if Redwood can provide a short SOF (statement of work) outlining the trial services and name a point-of-contact for billing (we'll send a PO if the SOW is ok).

On the schedule: May 26 kickoff is fine. Please put me down for 10:30am PT. I'll have our engineering lead (Anita Rao) join for the first 30 minutes.

Thanks — Alex

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Klein <alex.klein@syndicateanalytics.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 10:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Syndicate Analytics - trial roadmap, success metrics, and ownership

Looping in a couple of details from CS/QA side so Alex has visibility into our measurement approach.

Evaluation harness notes:
- Quality scoring: we'll run the golden prompts through a blind-review process. Each response is labeled pass/fail against acceptance criteria in sample_prompts.csv. Labels are driven by a 3-person reviewer panel for edge cases.
- Cost accounting: Redwood will provide raw token counts (input/output) and a per-token billable calculation; for fairness we'll exclude system prompts and hidden diagnostics from the cost denominator.
- Hallucination detection: we will flag outputs where the model returns verifiably incorrect facts based on the provided ground truth; we'll include an adjudication report for any disputed items.

Measurement windows and artifacts:
- Week 1: functional report (sample run + pass-rate) — deliverable by EOD Fri, Jun 2
- Week 2: throughput report + p95/p99 latency histograms — deliverable by EOD Fri, Jun 9
- Week 3: cost rundown and steady-state quality audit — deliverable by EOD Tue, Jun 13

If Procurement needs a concise SOW, Ben — I can draft a one-page trial SOW that calls out environment, duration, success gates, and responsibilities. Will share for review.

Thanks — Marissa
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Klein <alex.klein@syndicateanalytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 15:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Syndicate Analytics - trial roadmap, success metrics, and ownership

Alex — great, thanks for the quick replies and for confirming the kickoff. Notes / confirmations: 
- Throughput: we'll start with your requested 80 reqs/sec baseline and include a controlled ramp test to 120 reqs/sec during Week 2 to validate headroom.
- Token cost calc: we will share a short example spreadsheet that shows how input vs output tokens are computed and the final per-token aggregation. I'll attach the spreadsheet to the SOW draft.
- SOW: Marissa to draft a one-page SOW. Ben to circulate SOW + example cost calc to Procurement by Wed EOD.

Kickoff: confirmed for May 26, 10:30am PT — calendar invite link below. Agenda (30m): 1) introductions & scope, 2) environment/access checklist, 3) quick demo of trial tenant, 4) next steps + owners.

Action items:
- Ben: send SOW + cost example to procurement (due Wed EOD)
- Marissa: share evaluation harness README and labeling guidelines (due Thu)
- Alex: send sample traffic profile & compliance checklist (due Thu)

See you on Tuesday for kickoff.

—
Ben Carter
